overview_description.description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the spa, salon, and med spa industries. The system supports large spa, salon, med-spa, and fitness chains with the tools to expand the network while increasing unit-level performance. In addition to being a true enterprise solution for this industry, it also supports small ad medium-sized businesses. The all-in-one system helps clients grow and manage operations.

The company enables users to manage every aspect of a business in a comprehensive mobile solution with online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs, and more. It helps clients streamline systems and decrease costs while enhancing customer retention, and spending.

It was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.
